title: Dynamic Conflict Clustering with Lightweight Learning and Strategic Repair for Distributed Constraint Satisfaction
abstract: arXiv:2610.15658v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Distributed Constraint Satisfaction Problems (DCSPs) model distributed decision-making in multi-agent systems, where agents assign values to local variables while satisfying shared constraints. However, many DCSP solvers still rely on broad, repeated peer-to-peer communication and are largely reactive, with limited support for strategic coordination or learning. This increases communication overhead, can lead to stagnation, and reduces the success of hard instances. Hence, we propose Dynamic Conflict Clustering-Incomplete (DCC-Incomplete), a repair-based solver that combines conflict-centred decomposition, structured coordination, strategic repair, and lightweight learning for stagnation recovery. translated_title: 面向分布式约束满足的动态冲突聚类、轻量级学习与策略性修复方法
translated_abstract: 分布式约束满足问题建模了多智能体系统中的分布式决策过程，其中各智能体在满足共享约束的前提下为局部变量赋值。然而，许多DCSP求解器仍然依赖广泛且重复的点对点通信，且在很大程度上是被动的，对策略性协调或学习的支持有限。这会带来较高的通信开销，可能导致求解停滞，并降低困难实例的求解成功率。为此，我们提出了动态冲突聚类-不完全版，这是一种基于修复的求解器，融合了以冲突为中心的分解、结构化协调、策略性修复以及用于停滞恢复的轻量级学习。DCC-Incomplete将问题中未解决的部分划分为冲突簇，并通过协调层将通信限制在同一冲突区域内的智能体之间。此外，它还引入了记忆引导的重启机制，使智能体与簇……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出DCC-Incomplete求解器，通过动态冲突聚类分解、限制通信范围的结构化协调、策略性修复与记忆引导的轻量级学习，有效降低通信开销并提升困难DCSP实例的求解成功率。
en_tdlr: DCC-Incomplete, a repair-based DCSP solver that combines dynamic conflict clustering, structured coordination with restricted communication, strategic repair, and lightweight memory-guided learning to reduce communication overhead and improve success on hard instances.
